name: dashboard-builder
// why this exists: CI runs the validator scripts on Python 3.12 and lints the shell entry
point with shellcheck. A contributor whose local Python is older, or who
has no shellcheck, finds that out from a red build rather than from their
own terminal. This container is the same two things, nothing more — the
validator scripts are stdlib-only, so there are no runtime dependencies
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck
